title: Quarterly earnings summary acme corp
overview: Acme Corp reported second quarter revenue of 1.2 billion dollars, up 8 percent from a year earlier. [1] Operating margin expanded to 22 percent as cloud services grew faster than the legacy hardware segment. [1] The company raised its full year guidance and announced a 500 million dollar share buyback. [1]
